paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Front Grille is designed to fit the BMW M3 G80 Sedan and G81 Touring Wagon 2021+, and the BMW M4 G82 Coupe and G83 Convertible 2021+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this carbon fibre grille delivers a refined motorsport-inspired upgrade to the front fascia of the G8X platform.

Engineered as a direct replacement for the factory grille insert, it sharpens the front of the M3 and M4 with a more purposeful look that complements the wider Alpha-N body kit range. The classic 2x2 twill weave is finished in a durable gloss clear coat that protects the carbon while highlighting the depth and detail of the weave, integrating cleanly with the aggressive design language of the G8X. Whether kept in exposed carbon or paired with a custom paint finish on the centre bar, the grille delivers a distinctive upgrade to the front end.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Autoclave-cured construction with UV-resistant gloss clear coat
Direct replacement for the factory grille insert
Uses original BMW mounting tabs — no modifications required
ft: Alpha-N Carbon Front Grille for BMW M3 G80 G81  / M4 G82 G83 2021+
